subject: Air freight quote: MUC to LAX
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from MUC to LAX (Los Angeles, US) for our furniture samples? The cargo will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-29, and we will deliver it to Munich airport (MUC) ourselves.

Lot 1: 1 piece, gross weight 618 kg, volume 0.74 cbm
Lot 2: 1 piece, gross weight 380 kg, volume 1.65 cbm

Please send both lots together as one consignment under a single air waybill. Could you give us one all-in price in EUR for the complete shipment and confirm the earliest available departure and arrival?

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
